readerCopy.headline: Generosity can get expensive fast.
readerCopy.body:
The bigger dinner, nicer gift, extra night out, or more elaborate gesture can feel completely reasonable in the moment. You may also give more time because you want someone to feel cared for, then notice later that the week now belongs to everybody except you.

Jupiter square Venus can make more feel like proof of love, taste, or abundance. Before spending or promising, ask what the gesture is actually trying to solve. Affection does not need to become a bill you resent later.
